summary.text: Kyle Clayton is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Kevin Payne.
He is a Realtor and has served on the Washington Elementary School District Governing Board since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Clayton earned a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 2010, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working as a realtor and entrepreneur.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Legislative District 27, is raising his family there, and has a child enrolled in the Washington Elementary School District.
Clayton is an at-large member of the Washington Elementary School District board, having assumed office on January 1, 2023, and said in the survey that he currently serves as Board President.
He also said he is a member of the Shaw Butte Neighborhood Alliance.
In the survey, Clayton listed his campaign messages as education, lowering costs for Arizona families, and fiscal responsibility and fairness.
He said he would work to raise per-pupil funding, fully fund full-day kindergarten and reform Empowerment Scholarship Account vouchers.
He listed the Arizona State Building & Construction Trades Council as an endorser.
